external_entities.name: supplier
external_entities.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the supplier document portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: category manager
external_entities.description: Category managers review uploaded compliance paperwork and approve or reject it from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: vendor
external_entities.description: The vendor hosts the supplier document portal and pushes a nightly supplier data extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

processes.name: supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload compliance paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.

processes.name: supplier master service
processes.description: A service in our cloud account that loads the supplier data extract and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: vendor platform
data_stores.description: The vendor's platform where supplier compliance documents remain.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in our cloud account that receives the nightly supplier data extract before it is picked up by the supplier master service.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.

data_stores.name: supplier database
data_stores.description: The database in our cloud account into which the supplier master service writes supplier records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: A supplier uploads compliance paperwork to the supplier document portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A supplier signs in to the supplier document portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers sign in with a username and password that the vendor issues to them.

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: A category manager reviews uploaded paperwork in the supplier document portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded

data_flows.name: approve or reject
data_flows.description: A category manager approves or rejects uploaded paperwork in the supplier document portal.
data_flows.data_description: Approval or rejection of uploaded compliance paperwork.

data_flows.name: push extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: System description: "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." System description: "The runbook for the landing bucket says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is." These are incompatible positive claims, so encryption in transit is unknown.

data_flows.name: load file
data_flows.description: The supplier master service loads the supplier data extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database.
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract.

trust_boundaries.name: vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-controlled hosting environment for the SaaS portal and vendor platform.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: Our cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier document portal presents a web interface because the source identifies it as a portal.
assumptions.basis: The source names the component "Supplier document portal"; a portal is a web application interface.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier compliance records are confidential because they include staff contact details and business compliance documents.
assumptions.basis: The source says the platform holds insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier data in the landing bucket is confidential because the extract contains supplier records derived from the compliance paperwork and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the bucket as receiving a supplier data extract, and the portal data includes contact details for supplier staff.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier records in the supplier database are confidential because the database receives supplier records derived from the compliance paperwork and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The source says the supplier master service writes supplier records into the database, while the described supplier data includes staff contact details.
